items.subEn: His November 4 birthday reliably gives a Scorpio Sun — the one placement the public record confirms
Say plainly when a Moon or Ascendant is listed, because those shift with a birth time no source has verified
Read Scorpio themes as focus and intensity, not as the cause of a World Cup goal or a transfer
Notice when a trait is chosen only because it flatters the highlight reel — an honest read survives his quiet games too
